Position : Mainframe Systems Programer
Location: 55 Farmington Avenue   Hartford,  Connecticut (Hybrid)
Last date of submission :06/15/2026
Job Summary:
Seeking a highly experienced Mainframe Database Migration Specialist to support a critical, time-sensitive enterprise data migration initiative. The consultant will be responsible for analyzing existing mainframe applications, developing extraction and conversion processes, modifying COBOL programs and JCL, and ensuring the successful migration of IMS and legacy data assets to target platforms. The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment with aggressive project timelines.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze existing mainframe applications, databases, files, and batch processing workflows to support migration activities.
Design, develop, and execute data extraction processes from IMS databases and legacy mainframe data sources.
Create, modify, and support JCL required for data extracts, file transfers, conversion processing, and migration testing.
Perform COBOL program analysis and code modifications to support data extraction, transformation, validation, and reconciliation requirements.
Review and update FTP/SFTP processes to support secure transmission of migration files between source and target environments.
Utilize IMS utilities and BMC Utilities for IMS to unload, extract, validate, and reconcile database content.
Develop and execute data validation and reconciliation procedures to ensure data integrity throughout the migration lifecycle.
Support file mapping, field-level transformation logic, and data conversion specifications.
Troubleshoot batch failures, abends, data discrepancies, and performance issues related to migration processing.
Collaborate with database administrators, architects, business analysts, and project teams to define migration requirements and resolve technical challenges.
Create technical documentation, migration runbooks, implementation procedures, and production support documentation.
Participate in migration testing, system integration testing, user acceptance testing, and production implementation activities.
Provide production support during migration cutover and post-implementation stabilization periods.
Identify opportunities for automation using CLIST, REXX, File-AID, and other mainframe utilities.
Ensure compliance with enterprise change management, security, and audit requirements.
Required Qualifications
10+ years of Mainframe Development experience.
Expert-level COBOL programming experience.
Strong JCL development and troubleshooting skills.
Extensive IMS Database experience.
Experience with BMC Utilities for IMS.
Experience developing large-scale data extracts and conversion processes.
Strong understanding of FTP/SFTP file transfer methodologies.
Proven experience supporting enterprise data migration or modernization initiatives.
Experience performing data analysis, reconciliation, and validation.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a deadline-driven environment.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with File-AID.
Experience with EZtrieve.
Experience with CLIST and REXX automation.
Prior experience with legacy modernization or cloud migration projects.
Experience supporting financial services, insurance, healthcare, or government mainframe environments.
Critical Success Factors
Ability to quickly assess complex legacy environments.
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting capabilities.
Excellent communication and documentation skills.
Ability to meet aggressive deadlines and deliver high-quality migration solutions under tight timelines

Onsite SharePoint & Workflow Developer  – ECM Migration

Location: Onsite , Experience: 8–12+ years ;  Employment Type: Full-time / Contract

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly experienced SharePoint & Workflow Developer to support a large-scale Enterprise Content Management (ECM) migration from IBM FileNet to SharePoint Online. The role involves designing, developing, and optimizing SharePoint-based solutions, workflows, and migration strategies while working closely with business and IT stakeholders onsite.

Key Responsibilities

ECM Migration (FileNet → SharePoint Online)

  • Lead and support migration of content, metadata, and workflows from IBM FileNet to SharePoint Online
  • Analyze existing FileNet repositories, document classes, and workflows
  • Design mapping strategies
  • Work with migration tools (e.g., ShareGate, Metalogix, or custom migration utilities)
  • Ensure data integrity, validation, and reconciliation post-migration

SharePoint Online Development

  • Design and develop solutions using SharePoint Online (Modern Experience)
  • Develop solutions using - SPFx (SharePoint Framework) & JavaScript, TypeScript, REST APIs
  • Implement governance and best practices for SharePoint architecture
  • Integrate SharePoint Enterprise applications (e.g., SAP, CRM, legacy systems)
  • Develop custom APIs and connectors
  • Work Closely with Onsite team such as Business stakeholders, Architects & Migration teams as well as offshore team
  • Conduct workshops, requirement gathering, and demos onsite
  • Handle escalations and critical production issues

Workflow Development

  • Design and develop workflows using - Power Automate (preferred) & SharePoint Designer (legacy workflows, if applicable)
  • Re-engineer FileNet workflows into SharePoint-based processes
  • Integrate workflows with external systems
  • Ensure performance optimization and error handling in workflows

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Experience in ECM migration strategies and execution
  • Strong experience in SharePoint Online (O365)
  • Expertise in: SPFx (SharePoint Framework), JavaScript / TypeScript & HTML/CSS
  • Hands-on experience with Power Automate workflows
  • Experience with migration tools (ShareGate / Metalogix / AvePoint)
  • Knowledge of REST APIs, Microsoft Graph API
  • Experience with Azure services (Logic Apps, Functions – plus)
Strong understanding of IBM FileNet P8: Document classes, metadata, Content Engine,  Process Engine, FileNet workflows

Number of Positions - 1

NOTE: I am looking for a level 4 (Senior, most experienced) machinist, I am also open to a part-time worker if the candidate has the appropriate experience.
 

In need of an Experimental Machinist to work at its Logan, UT facility.  This position will be hired to level 4 (Senior).

 Our Logan, UT team researches, designs, develops, produces, and tests a variety of mechanical, electrical/electronic, and electro-optical equipment and systems including low background infrared scene/source generators, optical collimators and scan mirror systems, cryogenic positioning hardware, infrared imaging, and instrumentation of vacuum/space/environment chambers. We support multiple prime contractors in the development and production of both test systems and flight hardware for a multitude of applications including tactical missiles, launch detection, and missile defense systems. Our work protects our country from enemy threats.

 Job Description:

  • Plans the layout, fabrication, and testing of mechanical devices; sets up and operates any type of precision machine tool to make original parts, tools, mechanisms, and devices for experimental purposes.
  • Identifies raw material requirements for parts to be machined.
  • Solves problems relative to work-holding arrangement, unusual materials, machine settings, tools, product specifications, and fabrication methods for production process.
  • Normally performs precision work to exacting tolerances and dimensions for research engineers in a developmental laboratory condition.
  • May monitor and verify quality in accordance with statistical process or other control procedures.
  • Typically requires completion of a formal apprenticeship and many years of precision all-around machining experience on unusual, original, and intricate layout, machining, and assembly tasks.

  Basic Qualifications – Machinist level 4

  • High school diploma or equivalent education
  • Minimum 6 years of experience working in a machine shop
  • Ability to interpret blueprints, sketches, GD&T, and other engineering specifications
  • Working knowledge of shop floor mathematics and measuring tools/equipment
  • Ability to use basic hand tools and precision measuring instruments
  • Ability to set up and operate a variety of manual machine tools including lathes, milling machines, and grinders
  • Ability to set up, program, and operate CNC machines including the use of Mastercam software
  • Ability to lift up to 50lbs
  • Ability to work safely and with concern for the safety of others

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associates Degree
  • 6+ years of CNC 3-5-axis machining experience
  • Experience with and fundamental understanding of G-Code
  • CNC Machinist Certification from an accredited Trade School  
  • Ability to understand and work with knowledge of Lean manufacturing principles and disciplines. 
  • Experience in following written set-up instructions and/or performing unique setups
  • Demonstrated ability to solve unique machining challenges including reworking parts
  • Experience with Haas VMCs and/or EZ-Trak mills (Milltronics controls)
  • Experience with CNC lathes
  • Experience with EDM equipment
  • Experience TIG/GTAW welding aluminum and stainless steel
  • Excellent communication, problem solving, and troubleshooting skills
  • Willingness to learn and possess a positive team working attitude

Job Description:

 

We are currently seeking a Sr. Product Design Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will design consumer products with a specific focus on plastics that meet functional, aesthetic, safety and cost requirements while supporting cross-functional engineering and manufacturing needs. You will contribute technical expertise throughout the product development cycle, including concept creation, prototyping and durability evaluation. You will also collaborate across teams, clearly communicate design intent and work with a range of materials to deliver reliable, high-quality product solutions. Applicants should have a strong understanding of product design principles, including functionality, durability, safety and cost considerations. The ideal candidate also possesses EIT and/or PE certification. 

A day on the job looks like this:

  • Partnering with Quality to evaluate testing results, address design risks and ensure solutions meet performance requirements 

  • Representing the engineering perspective in product development discussions, applying technical judgment to align designs with project goals 

  • Providing detailed responses to engineering and technical requests from cross-functional partners 

  • Building proof-of-concept models and prototypes using in-house 3-D printers and related tools 

  • Sharing design concepts and recommendations during product reviews and team discussions 

  • Collaborating across departments including international cross-functional partners to clearly translate technical concepts and support effective teamwork 

  • Performing stress analyses to support durability and performance assessment 

Qualifications

Got the skills and experience? Here’s what we’re looking for:

Required: 

  • 6+ years of experience in design engineering 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering 

  • Experience in:  

    • Principles of plastic part design, complex part assembly, GD&T, material selection   

    • Plastic part manufacturing (injection and blow molding), decoration and secondary operations (sonic welding, assembly, etc) 

    • Engineering and development of toys (or children’s products) and educational materials

    • Prototyping tools 

  • Proficiency in 3-D CAD design (SolidWorks), including assemblies and detailed drawings 

  • Strong understanding of product design principles, including functionality, durability, safety and cost considerations 

  • Advanced knowledge of manufacturing processes and production methods 

  • Advanced knowledge of 3D modeling techniques for aesthetic and functional parts (Moldflow/FEA) 

  • Hands-on experience supporting manufacturing activities (e.g., vendor validation, inspections, assembly support, troubleshooting production issues)

Role: Senior Test Engineer

Location: Dallas; TX.

Duration: 24 months +

Visa: Open/ Any, however Min. 7 + Yrs of Exp. Mandatory.

Exp. Level: 9+ Yrs, Min 7+ Yrs for Strong candidates.

 

 

Job Summary:

 

As a member of the system test team, the Senior test engineer will actively participate in all phases of the software development life cycle. The Test engineer will gather requirements, conduct analysis, create application test plans and test cases based on business requirements and design, work with development team or clients to troubleshoot, resolve, document problems, perform various types of testing (compliance, integration, regression and acceptance), execute test cases/scripts (manual and automated), validate and present output results, test bug fixes, enter and track defects and create test processes and procedures as needed

 

Duties & Responsibilities:

 

            You will work with multiple cross functional engineering teams (Mechanical, Electrical, Controls, Software and Simulation etc.) to develop test strategies to ensure a high-quality system that addresses all customer requirements in a timely manner and within the allocated budget.

•           You will also interface and work directly with customers on requirements and project managers to coordinate project test activities.  You will design and develop customized testing procedures and oversee projects from initial testing through local or nationwide deployment.

•           You will review customer documentation to identify  and analyze all requirements

•           You will design test plans, test data test environment, scenarios, procedures and scripts to accurately assess that the developed system addresses all customer requirements.

•           You will create detailed, step-by-step documentation of test procedures to ensure repeatability, coverage of customer requirements and compliance with standards.

•           You will communicate clearly and effectively with project teams , project management and customers to facilitate quick resolution of problems and document resolution agreements.

•           You will identify, analyze and create detailed records of problems that appear during testing and work directly with developers to find solutions and develop retesting procedures.

•           You will track internal or customer reported problems, resolutions and bug fixes throughout testing procedure with standardized tool such as JIRA.

•           You will design and implement applicable automated testing tools and upgrade them as needed to ensure currency and accuracy.

•           You will provide frequent feedback to developers, including recommendations for improvements, evaluation of problems, potential solutions and discussion of further test requirements.

•           You will represent the company in customer-facing technical meetings supporting the project management, development and execution through various customer test phases.

•           You will ensure discipline related technical processes, procedures and best practices are followed in test engineering activities.

•           You will be willing to travel to the customer site to support software installation, system testing and troubleshooting.    

 

Required Skills & Abilities:

 

1.          Technical Proficiency:

•                     Programming Languages: Knowledge of languages such as VB, C, C++. etc.

•                     Manual Testing: Strong skills in manual testing techniques and methodologies.

2.         Testing Frameworks:

•                     Familiarity with various testing frameworks and their implementation.

3.         Quality Assurance:

•                     Understanding of QA processes, standards and best practices.

•                     Ability to design and execute comprehensive test plans and test cases.

4.         Problem-Solving:

•                     Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills to identify and resolve defects.

5.         Communication:

•                     Excellent verbal and written communication skills for effective collaboration with development teams and stakeholders.

•                     Ability to document test results and create detailed reports.

6.         Leadership and Mentoring:

•                     Experience in leading and mentoring junior testers.

•                     Ability to manage and coordinate testing activities within a team.

7.         Project Management:

•                     Skills in managing testing projects, including planning, scheduling and tracking progress.

8.         Attention to Detail:

•                     A keen eye for detail to ensure thorough testing and high-quality software.

9.         Continuous Learning:

•                     Commitment to staying updated with the latest testing tools, technologies and industry trends.

 

Education:

College Degree
